auth: Authorization: Bearer <secret key>  (Roqqu dashboard, Security section)

endpoints.title: Get price of all tokens
endpoints.summary: Gets the current prices of all tokens on roqqu

endpoints.title: Get specific token price
endpoints.summary: For retrieving a single token's price

params.name: symbol
params.description: This is the token symbol of the token you intend to retrieve data for

endpoints.title: Get price history of token
endpoints.summary: Gets the entire price history of a token on roqqu
endpoints.note: Returns roughly the last 100 to 500 price points, newest first. Store your own copy for older history.

params.name: symbol
params.description: This is the token symbol of the token you intend to retrieve data for

endpoints.title: Addresses and accounts
endpoints.note: Rate limited to 1 call per 100 seconds. Going faster gets your IP blocked for 10 hours. EOS, HIVE and STEEM use an account name in place of an address.

params.name: symbol
params.description: This is the token symbol of the token you intend to retrieve data for

params.name: addr
params.description: This is the address of the wallet that you wish to retrieve data for

endpoints.title: Generate Wallet Address
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to generate a new wallet address for a token
endpoints.note: Supports btc, eth and trx only.

params.name: token
params.description: This is the token symbol of the token you intend to generate a new address for

400.message: wallet generation for token not supported

endpoints.title: Get Wallets
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to retrieve all wallets addresses for a specific token
endpoints.note: Returns every wallet ever generated for the token, with no paging. Call it sparingly.

params.name: token
params.description: This is the symbol of the token with the type of wallet you want to retrieve

endpoints.title: Delete Wallet
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to delete a particular wallet
endpoints.note: Supports btc, eth and trx. Roqqu still credits coins sent to a deleted address, so never share it again.

params.name: token
params.description: This is the token symbol of the type of wallet you want to delete

params.name: address
params.description: This is the wallet address you intend to delete from your account

endpoints.title: Send Token
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to send tokens to wallet addresses
endpoints.note: Moves real crypto. Swap the symbol in the path for other coins, e.g. /user/send-btc. memo is only for BNB, EOS, HIVE and STEEM; tag is for Ripple.

params.name: token
params.description: Coin symbol, e.g. btc, eth, trx

params.name: amount
params.description: This is the amount of token you want to send

params.name: wallet
params.description: This is the recipient wallet address that will receive the token

params.name: memo
params.description: This is only used for BNB, EOS, HIVE and STEEM, these tokens use the optional memo system

params.name: tag
params.description: This is only required for XRP transfers

endpoints.title: BVN Verification
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to verify user's BVN information from the banking system
endpoints.note: Costs NGN 20 per successful lookup, taken from your Roqqu wallet.

params.name: bvn
params.description: This is the user BVN number you want to retrieve the data for

endpoints.title: Get Banks
endpoints.summary: Endpoint retrieves all banks active within the Roqqu ecosystem
endpoints.note: Use these exact bank names with Bank Account Resolve.

examples.200:
{
    "status": "success",
    "message": "all banks retrieved",
    "data": [
        "Access Bank",
        "Aso Savings",
        "Eco Bank",
        "Fidelity Bank Plc",
        "First Bank of Nigeria",
        "First Bank of Nigeria Plc",
        ...
    ]
}

params.name: account_number
params.description: This is the account number you wish to verify it's validity

params.name: bank
params.description: This is the name of the bank gotten from the bank list api

endpoints.title: NIN Verification
endpoints.summary: Document that explains how to verify user's NIN information
endpoints.note: Costs NGN 100 per successful lookup, taken from your Roqqu wallet.

params.name: nin
params.description: The National identification Number

examples.200:
{
  status: 'success',
  message: 'NIN data retrieved successfully',
  data: {
    nin: '00000000000',
    first_name: 'ADA',
    last_name: 'OKAFOR',
    middle_name: 'CHIOMA',
    gender: 'm',
    phone_number: '080XXXXXXXX',
    address: '12 SAMPLE STREET, ENUGU',
    lga_of_residence: 'Enugu South',
    date_of_birth: '19-01-1989',
    nationality: 'Nigerian'
  }
}

endpoints.title: Airtime Recharge
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to recharge airtime on phone numbers
endpoints.note: Moves real money from your Roqqu balance.

params.name: phone_number
params.description: This is the phone number you intend to recharge

params.name: amount
params.description: This is the amount you intend to recharge on the phone number

endpoints.title: Get Data Bundles
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to get the different data bundles of the different providers
endpoints.note: Each bundle's variation_code is what Data Subscription needs.

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the name of the provider, they are mtn, glo, etisalat and airtel

endpoints.title: Data Subscription
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to activate a data bundle for a phone number
endpoints.note: Moves real money from your Roqqu balance.

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the name of the provider, they are mtn, glo, etisalat and airtel

params.name: variation_code
params.description: This is the variation code retrieved from the get data bundles endpoint

params.name: phone_number
params.description: This is the recipient phone number that will receive the data bundle

endpoints.title: Get Cable Bundles
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to retrieve the different cable subscriptions

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the provider of the cable, dstv, gotv and startimes currently enabled

endpoints.title: Verify IUC Number
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to verify the validity of an IUC number of a decoder

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the provider of the cable, dstv, gotv and startimes currently enabled

params.name: iuc
params.description: This is the unique identity number of the decoder

endpoints.title: Verify Meter Number
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to verify a meter number to ensure it's correct

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the meter provider, eko, ikeja and ph supported

params.name: meter_type
params.description: This is the type of meter, prepaid or postpaid

params.name: meter_number
params.description: This is the meter number that needs to be verified

endpoints.title: Electricity Meter Recharge
endpoints.summary: This document explains how to purchase and refill electricity meters
endpoints.note: Roqqu keeps NGN 100 of the amount as a fee. Verify the meter first.

params.name: provider
params.description: This is the meter provider, eko, ikeja and ph supported

params.name: meter_type
params.description: This is the type of meter, prepaid or postpaid

params.name: meter_number
params.description: This is the meter number that needs to be verified

params.name: amount
params.description: This is the amount you intend to recharge to the meter

params.name: phone_number
params.description: This is the phone number that will receive the token code after paying

webhook.title: Receive Token (deposit webhook)
webhook.summary: Roqqu POSTs to the URL you set on the dashboard whenever coins land on one of your generated addresses.

payload.secret: <the secret you set on the dashboard>

webhook.note: Compare secret with the one you stored before trusting anything, then confirm the deposit with Get Wallets.
